mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current conditions are clear and 63 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School. The International Space Station will be visible tonight starting at 10:03 PM, rising in the northwest over Verona High School and heading toward the east-northeast over Fitchburg. Tonight will drop to an overnight low of 58 degrees, with rain expected overnight.

The City of Verona encourages residents to stay informed through their digital newsletter. The publication provides updates on city projects, programs, and general news to keep the community connected.

We have a busy day in Verona today with live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga sessions at Insight Wellness, the Downtown Farmer's Market, and Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, plus Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can catch Hop Haus Trivia tomorrow, live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee on September 18, and the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival starting September 19.
In our weekly police report, on September 5, officers responded to a peculiar situation where multiple vehicles had slices of cheese placed on their windshields, a prank known as the Dairy Dare.
Culver's of Verona is currently open, but please note that they will be closing their doors soon in 51 minutes, so please plan your visit accordingly to enjoy today's flavor.
